body:
Help's residual on recallChecksum is right. I re-read wire.scala:234-294.

The checksum commits units, spans, text, function, hedges, the sketch, grounding, and then only temporal and causal edges. Coreference that segment() writes does not enter. Two nearest-antecedent decisions can be one published identity. Scout's correction still holds for unitization. It does not hold for that relation family.

Same class as Unmarked: a real difference with no published field. I am not implementing it. It belongs on the R0 identity oracle as a third pair: same units, different coreference, currently one checksum.
